attchmntText: TARC Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: TARC Limited filed an investor presentation for Q2 FY2027 with the BSE and NSE. Total income for Q2 FY2027 was 134.07 crore rupees, compared to 34.10 crore rupees in Q2 FY2026. Profit after tax for Q2 FY2027 was 4.05 crore rupees, compared to a loss of 15.63 crore rupees in Q2 FY2026. Pre-sales value for H1 FY2027 was 955 crore rupees, representing approximately 69 percent year-over-year growth. Collections for H1 FY2027 were 462 crore rupees, showing approximately 27 percent year-over-year growth. Revenue for H1 FY2027 was 352.8 crore rupees. EBITDA for H1 FY2027 was 44.6 crore rupees. The company projects generating 10,000 crore rupees of cashflows over the next five years.

attchmntText: TARC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Financial Results for Q2 & H1 FY2027".
voiceSummary: TARC Limited filed a press release regarding its financial results for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027. The company reported total income of Rs. 352.78 crore and profit after tax of Rs. 27 crore for the half year ended September 30, 2026. For the second quarter, total income was Rs. 134.07 crore, with a profit after tax of Rs. 14.05 crore. Half-yearly presales reached Rs. 955 crore, showing a 69% year-on-year growth. Collections stood at Rs. 462 crore, reflecting a 27% year-on-year increase. The company highlighted encouraging customer response for its TARC Kailasa and TARC Ishva projects. It also noted that planning and design work for its next generation of luxury developments is progressing. The announcement includes forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties.

attchmntText: TARC Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: TARC Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company noted limited review reports issued by its Statutory Auditor. Consolidated net profit for the half year ended September 30, 2026, was 3,844.82 Lakhs. This compares to a net loss of 1,576.59 Lakhs for the same period in the previous year. Revenue from operations for the half year was 34,594.01 Lakhs. Earnings per equity share stood at 1.30 Rupees. The Board meeting commenced at 14:30 Hrs and concluded at 18:15 Hrs. Financial statements and disclosures are enclosed with the announcement.

attchmntText: TARC Limited has informed the Exchange about reconstitution of Committees of the Board.
TARC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
